name: jarvis
description: Let Claude talk to you out loud through Jarvis, your voice assistant on this computer.
long_description:
Jarvis Desktop is a voice-first personal assistant. With this extension Claude can speak short updates, ask you a question out loud and wait for your answer, show a notification, start background tasks in Jarvis and read what Jarvis remembers about you.

The Jarvis app must be running on this computer. Calls go only to the local Jarvis process (loopback); risky actions still need your approval on screen.

tools.name: jarvis_speak
tools.description: Say a short message out loud on the user's computer (≤ 300 characters).

tools.name: jarvis_ask_user
tools.description: Ask the user a question out loud and wait for their spoken or clicked answer. Use when you are blocked and need a decision.

tools.name: jarvis_notify
tools.description: Show a desktop notification to the user (silent).

tools.name: jarvis_start_task
tools.description: Start a background task on the user's computer with Jarvis (Claude Code, Codex or the Home agent). Risky steps still require the user's approval on their screen.

tools.name: jarvis_list_sessions
tools.description: List Jarvis background sessions with their status and latest activity.

tools.name: jarvis_session_result
tools.description: Get the final result text of a Jarvis session.

tools.name: jarvis_remember
tools.description: Save a durable preference or fact about the user in Jarvis memory.

tools.name: jarvis_recall
tools.description: List what Jarvis remembers about the user (preferences and facts).
